channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula não vai ao Peru para não ser visto como peça de museu
item.description: Lula chose not to travel to Peru for Keiko Fujimori's inauguration, avoiding being seen as a museum piece amid successive right-wing victories in Latin American regional elections. Instead of attending in person, he sent Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira as Brazil's representative.

item.title: Ricardo Salles declara R$ 9 milhões em bens, incluindo casa em Portugal
item.description: Ricardo Salles, former Environment Minister and Senate candidate for São Paulo, declared R$ 9 million in assets to the TSE, including a rural house in Portugal valued at R$ 3 million — a 127.95% increase from his 2022 declaration, when he reported approximately R$ 4 million in assets.

item.title: Líder do PL declara ao TSE ter 500 mil em dinheiro vivo, mas PF levou quase tudo
item.description: PL leader in the Chamber, Sóstenes Cavalcante, declared to the TSE that he held R$ 500,000 in cash from the sale of a property and a land valued at R$ 100,000. Nearly all of the cash amount (R$ 470,000) was seized by the Federal Police during Operation Galho Fraco in December last year. Cavalcante stated the money has legitimate origins and claimed he is a victim of judicial persecution.

item.title: Lula defende o SUS e alfineta Trump: "Saúde não é só para rico"
item.description: President Lula defended Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) during a visit to the Federal Hospital of Andaraí in Rio de Janeiro, criticizing Donald Trump's decision to cut WHO funding and asserting that healthcare access should not depend on financial status. He cited his own skin cancer treatment in the public system to illustrate that SUS provides equal care for rich and poor, emphasizing that 'healthcare treatment is not only for the rich'.

item.title: Zema defende Milei, mas diz que crítica poderia ser "mais civilizada"
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for Novo, defended Javier Milei's criticisms of Lula and Brazil but suggested the Argentine president could have expressed himself in a 'more civilized' manner, using official channels like an embassy protest note. He stated that, despite the tone, Milei is 'correct' in his accusations, particularly regarding Lula being a former convict and founder of the São Paulo Forum. Zema also criticized the STF, referring to 'three rotten fruits' that need to be replaced.

item.title: Flávio apresenta nova petição ao STF contra Lula por “ameaça”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a new petition with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against President Lula (PT), alleging the president committed the crimes of threat and incitement by associating 'traitors of the homeland' with the death penalty. The action is part of an existing criminal complaint against the president. The news was published by O Antagonista on Tuesday, the 28th.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE e X firmam parceria para combater a desinformação
item.description: The TSE and X Brasil have signed a memorandum of understanding to combat disinformation in the 2026 elections, integrating the Permanent Program to Counter Disinformation of the Electoral Justice. The partnership includes platform prompts directing users to official information, along with media literacy initiatives and training for TSE, TREs, and judicial staff on platform policies and identifying illegal content.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ao STF que Lula voltou a associá-lo à figura de traidor e citar enforcamento
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro submitted a petition to Justice Kassio Nunes Marques of the STF to include a new fact in the criminal complaint he filed against President Lula, claiming the president repeated rhetoric associating his image with hanging and treason. The defense argues Lula has revived linking the senator to this offensive discourse.

item.title: Presidência da Missão não tem nem terá ingerência sobre emendas, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, national president of Missão, told STF Minister Flávio Dino that the party's presidency has and will have no authority over the management, deliberation, or interference in the allocation of parliamentary amendments, stating that its competencies are strictly limited to those defined in the party's statute.

item.title: Ricardo Salles declara ao TSE possuir imóvel rural em Portugal
item.description: Federal deputy Ricardo Salles (Novo), Senate candidate for São Paulo, declared to the TSE a net worth of R$9 million, including a rural property in Portugal valued at R$3 million. His declared assets exceed those from 2022 (R$3.9 million) and are similar to 2018 (R$8.8 million). Salles, former Environment Minister under Bolsonaro, presents himself as a right-wing alternative to PL- and Bolsonaro clan-backed candidates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ao STF que Lula incentivou 'enforcamento' ao relacioná-lo a 'traidores da pátria'
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro presented new allegations to the STF that President Lula is inciting political violence by linking him to 'traitors of the homeland' and referencing the historical hanging of Joaquim Silvério dos Reis, suggesting this naturalizes the idea of his death. Lawyers claim Lula repeated the rhetoric at the PDT convention, using it as an electoral strategy to gain advantage, thereby endangering Flávio’s physical integrity and democratic health.

item.title: Moraes dá 48h para Daniel Silveira explicar vídeo eleitoral ao lado de Carlos Portinho
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes gave former federal deputy Daniel Silveira 48 hours to explain a video in which he appears alongside Senator Carlos Portinho urging support for Portinho’s re-election, violating a court order banning Silveira from using social networks. Silveira, convicted of threatening democracy and obstructing justice, is barred from using his own or others’ social media as a condition of his open regime; the video was removed from Portinho’s profile but remains in his stories. If Moraes finds a breach, he may revoke Silveira’s benefits and return him to semi-closed or closed imprisonment.

item.title: Moraes manda PGR se manifestar sobre depoimento cancelado de Flávio em inquérito que apura calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes has ordered the Prosecutor General's Office (PGR) to respond within 15 days regarding the cancellation of Flávio Bolsonaro's testimony in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula. Bolsonaro's defense submitted written arguments instead of appearing for the scheduled deposition on July 28, 2026, leading the Federal Police to cancel the hearing. The case stems from a post on X (formerly Twitter) in which Bolsonaro linked Lula to Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro and accused him of drug trafficking, money laundering, and electoral fraud.

item.title: EUA prorrogam estado de emergência contra o Brasil por 1 ano
item.description: The United States, under the Trump administration, has extended the national emergency declaration against Brazil for another year, citing threats to national security stemming from Brazilian Supreme Court decisions, including alleged censorship and imprisonment of individuals exercising free speech, as well as claimed political persecution of Jair Bolsonaro and his supporters. The measure, based on Executive Order 14323 from July 2025, does not impose new sanctions but remains in effect due to the annual renewal requirement under U.S. law.

item.title: Defesa de Flávio apresenta novo pedido de investigação após Lula citar enforcamento de 'traidor'
item.description: The defense of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has filed a new request with the STF to investigate President Lula for alleged threat and incitement to crime, after the president repeated in a PDT convention the association between 'traitor of the homeland' and hanging, previously used in a speech in Catalão (GO). Lawyers claim the statements are not isolated rhetorical slips but part of a deliberate strategy to incite political violence for electoral gain. The request is pending before Minister Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: Trump diz que Brasil interfere na economia dos EUA e prorroga tarifa de 50% por 1 ano
item.description: The U.S. extended by one year a 50% tariff on Brazilian imports, accusing the Lula government of interfering with the U.S. economy, suppressing free speech, violating human rights, and politically persecuting Bolsonaro and his supporters under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.

item.title: Porta-voz da Argentina minimiza críticas de Milei a Lula
item.description: Argentine Presidency spokesperson Adrian Ravier downplayed criticisms by President Javier Milei against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling them ideological differences and stating that insults came from both sides. Milei had labeled Lula a 'thief', 'socialist trash', and 'convict' during his attendance at the convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy under the Liberal Party in São Paulo. The Brazilian government had previously summoned Argentina’s ambassador to protest and demand explanations for the offensive remarks toward Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Lula pede que diretor da OMS leve recado a Trump sobre o SUS: 'Tratamento de saúde não é para rico'
item.description: Lula urged the WHO Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, to convey to the United States that Brazil's SUS provides high-quality healthcare to all citizens regardless of income, using his own prostate cancer treatment as an example. He stressed that healthcare access should not depend on financial status and urged Trump to see how a less wealthy country can ensure equal treatment. Lula declared the SUS is undergoing a 'revolution' and that no one should die due to lack of care because of poverty.

item.title: Prefeitos argentinos dizem que Milei ‘exportou constrangimento’ ao atacar Lula no Brasil
item.description: The Argentine Federation of Municipalities criticized President Javier Milei for insulting President Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, stating he 'exported embarrassment' and damaged Argentina-Brazil relations. The remarks sparked a diplomatic crisis, prompting Brazil to summon ambassadors and the STF to condemn the attacks as incompatible with civility.

item.title: Lula vai reunir ministros do STJ para sanção de projeto de lei no Palácio do Planalto
item.description: President Lula will host ministers of the Superior Tribunal of Justice (STJ) at the Planalto Palace next Tuesday for the presidential sanction of a bill regulating the federal relevance threshold, a new filter for admitting special appeals. The event was coordinated with current STJ president Herman Benjamin and supported by incoming president Luis Felipe Salomão, whom Lula confirmed attending the inauguration on August 19. The measure aims to reduce the case load at the STJ, strengthen uniform interpretation of federal law, and align the court with superior tribunals that prioritize precedent-setting over mere appellate review.

item.title: Eleições 2026: LinkedIn terá notícias e canal de denúncias em parceria com o TSE
item.description: The TSE and LinkedIn have signed an agreement to combat misinformation in the 2026 General Elections, including the launch of 'LinkedIn News' and a reporting channel. The partnership includes training, removal of malicious content, and increased transparency, integrating the Permanent Program to Counter Disinformation of the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Flávio fará gesto a Carlos Bolsonaro em evento em Santa Catarina
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will attend the PL convention in Santa Catarina on June 1st to support his younger brother Carlos Bolsonaro's (PL-SC) Senate campaign and reinforce the ticket with Caroline de Toni (PL). Although Carlos leads in polls, he remains technically tied with opponents, and party leaders expect him to pull ahead due to the Bolsonaro name and Flávio's presidential bid.

item.title: Duarte Júnior após Avante barrar candidatura ao Senado: "Covardes"
item.description: Federal deputy Duarte Júnior (Avante-MA) criticized Avante's veto of his Senate candidacy, calling those responsible 'cowards' and saying they 'messed with the wrong person'. He announced he will run for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies, emphasizing his stance against backroom deals and corruption in Maranhão, with public support and divine blessing.

item.title: “FNDC lança carta com propostas para democratizar a comunicação”
item.description: The FNDC will launch on Saturday (1st) a commitment letter to democratize communication in Brazil, proposing technological sovereignty, AI regulation, protection for journalists, and action against digital monopolies. The document aims to secure public endorsements from candidates and pre-candidates in the 2026 elections, defending public, community, and educational communication, while seeking to block privatization of strategic firms like Serpro and Dataprev and prevent politicians from owning media outlets.

item.title: Quaest testa disputas eleitorais com pesquisas em cinco estados do Brasil
item.description: Quaest will release five electoral polls between July 29 and 30, covering Bahia, São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Goiás, and Ceará. The surveys will assess voter intention for president, governor, and senator, highlighting the ACM Neto vs. Jerônimo Rodrigues race in Bahia. Releases are split: Bahia and SP on Wednesday, followed by RS, GO, and CE on Thursday.

item.title: PT aciona PGE para apurar quem bancou ida de Javier Milei a convenção do PL
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) has filed a request with Brazil's Electoral General Prosecutor's Office (PGE) to investigate potential irregularities surrounding the participation of Argentine President Javier Milei at the PL party convention that formalized its 2026 presidential candidate. The PT alleges the event may have been illegally funded by foreign interests or undeclared sources, constituting economic power abuse or the use of illicit resources in the electoral campaign. The PGE will assess whether there is evidence of illicit fundraising or violations of Brazilian electoral law.

item.title: Rogéria Bolsonaro deve disputar vaga na Câmara
item.description: Rogéria Bolsonaro, mother of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and former wife of ex-president Jair Bolsonaro, has decided to withdraw from the Senate alternate position on a ticket led by former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União) and will instead run for the Chamber of Deputés under the PL party in Rio de Janeiro. The decision was reported by Veja magazine and communicated to the state PL directory. Her candidacy strengthens the Bolsonaro family's presence in the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Após ter lançado candidata, presidente do DC elogia possível chapa de Romeu Zema com Joaquim Barbosa
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy party (DC), João Caldas, praised the potential ticket of Romeu Zema (Novo) and Joaquim Barbosa (former STF minister) as vice-presidential candidate, highlighting Zema’s readiness and the suitability of the pairing. Although DC had nominated Clariana Barão as its presidential candidate, Caldas indicated the candidacy could change due to ongoing party negotiations, stating 'politics is the art of compromise'. Joaquim Barbosa, who joined DC in May and was initially its pre-candidate, withdrew from the presidential race due to lack of resources, weak party structure, and poor polling numbers.

item.title: Parceria entre TSE e TikTok fortalece a integridade das informações eleitorais
item.description: The TSE and TikTok have signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen electoral information integrity for the 2026 elections, including the creation of an Elections 2026 Information Center on TikTok, electoral labels on related content, and a channel for analyzing complaints. The agreement, valid until December 31, 2026, is free of charge and part of the Permanent Program to Combat Disinformation of the Electoral Justice, aiming to inform voters and counter irregular content.

item.title: Estudo usado por Milei não diz que Brasil liderou 'campanha anti-Argentina'
item.description: The study cited by Javier Milei to accuse Brazil of leading an 'anti-Argentina campaign' does not contain that claim. Milei attended a pre-campaign event for Flávio Bolsonaro in São Paulo, where he also harshly criticized Lula, calling him a 'thief'. The misinformation was amplified by Milei, but the original source does not support his accusation.

item.title: Governo Trump relaciona Bolsonaro em nova ordem contra o Brasil
item.description: The Trump administration renewed the national emergency against Brazil, citing alleged political persecution of former President Jair Bolsonaro, without imposing new sanctions. The measure, published in the Federal Register, extends the 2025 decree that already linked Brazilian government actions to threats to U.S. national security. Bolsonaro is serving house arrest after being sentenced by the STF to 27 years in prison for his role in the January 8 coup attempt.

item.title: Presidente do PT do Recife se licencia de cargo para apoiar Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco
item.description: Osmar Ricardo, president of the PT in Recife, stepped down from his position to support Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) in her re-election bid, citing disagreements with the PT-PSB alliance and candidate João Campos. He criticized the PSB’s influence over the PT in Pernambuco, arguing Campos does not represent the state’s future and that governance favors economic interests over the public. The move comes amid potential dual slates for Lula, who had previously endorsed Campos in a video but avoided an official visit to the state due to internal party tensions.

item.title: Entenda o que é o estado de emergência dos EUA contra o Brasil
item.description: The U.S. government extended its national emergency declaration against Brazil for another year, maintaining the July 2025 declaration without imposing new sanctions. The extension is legally required to prevent automatic expiration and relies on allegations of censorship and arrests by Brazil's Supreme Federal Court, including claims of political persecution against Jair Bolsonaro and his allies.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro acreditam em volta de Magnitsky contra Moraes até eleição
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro believe that U.S. Magnitsky Act sanctions could be reapplied against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes amid rising Brazil-U.S. tensions. This possibility is seen as an effort to pressure the Brazilian judiciary, though no official confirmation of new measures has been made. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: João Campos se agarra a Lula
item.description: Former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) is seeking to strengthen his candidacy for governor of Pernambuco by aligning himself with President Lula (PT), emphasizing the importance of having a governor allied with the federal government. In an interview with Veja, Campos stated that a good relationship with Lula facilitates the articulation of policies and resources for the state.

item.title: João Campos minimiza crescimento de Raquel Lyra em pesquisa Genial/Quaest de Pernambuco: 'Cenário de equilíbrio'
item.description: PSB pre-candidate João Campos downplayed Governor Raquel Lyra’s lead in the latest Genial/Quaest poll, describing the race as a technical tie within the three-point margin of error. He emphasized the importance of President Lula’s support and noted that many voters are still unaware of their alliance, announcing a new campaign phase focused on interior visits. Although Lyra leads with 43% in the first round and 45% in a potential runoff, Campos maintains the race remains balanced.

item.title: O novo projeto político da mãe de Flávio Bolsonaro no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Rogéria Bolsonaro (PL), mother of Flávio and Carlos Bolsonaro, withdrew from the Senate suplency spot on Márcio Canella's (União) ticket and will run for Chamber of Deputies in Rio de Janeiro. The decision was driven by uncertainty over the PL-União-PP alliance in the state, worsened by Canella's arrest in a PF operation over alleged fuel station fund diversions. She is banking on her son Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign to boost her electoral prospects.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Telegram assina acordo com o TSE para coibir condutas ilegais
item.description: Telegram signed a memorandum of understanding with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to combat misinformation in the 2026 elections, including using the API to create an official bot and accessing the Electoral Misinformation Alert System (SIADE).

item.title: João Campos quer reforçar que é o candidato de Lula para reverter desvantagem em pesquisas
item.description: João Campos, former mayor of Recife and PSB candidate for governor of Pernambuco, aims to overturn his polling deficit against incumbent Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) by emphasizing his alignment with President Lula. His campaign seeks to leverage federal political capital to gain ground in the state.

item.title: Em manifestação enviada à PF, defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro nega calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense denied defaming Lula by associating him with Nicolás Maduro, arguing the post only speculated about a possible future mention of Lula in Maduro's testimony. Lawyers stated the phrase 'Lula will be denounced' does not attribute any crime to the president and submitted a written statement to the PF to replace a scheduled virtual hearing. The request was forwarded to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, rapporteur of the investigation into whether the senator committed defamation.

item.title: A resposta de Flávio à Justiça Eleitoral sobre o vídeo de ‘Jair Bolsonaro de IA’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense argued before the TSE that the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention is lawful, as it constitutes internal party propaganda in a closed event with clear disclosure of technological simulation, without intent to deceive. Lawyers compared the episode to the PT's 2018 use of Lula masks when he was ineligible. The case is under the rapporteurship of Minister Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita o Centro de Radioterapia do Hospital Federal do Andaraí
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits the Radiotherapy Center at the Federal Hospital of Andaraí in Rio de Janeiro on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, accompanied by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Health Minister Alexandre Padilha. Prior to the visit, the delegation toured the Mobile Dental Unit and a SAMU emergency vehicle, both located at the hospital. The event underscores the government’s focus on public health and international cooperation.

item.title: Ao TSE, campanha de Flávio compara vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro a caricatura e fantoches
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign told the TSE that the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro is not a deepfake because it clearly discloses its synthetic nature at the outset, complying with electoral rules requiring AI content labeling. The defense argues the video functions like traditional political tools such as puppets, caricatures, and animations, and lacks intent to deceive due to the upfront disclaimer. The PL requests the court deny the PT's urgent motion to remove the video.

item.title: Caiado diz que Milei fez escândalo, mas cobra diplomacia de Lula: 'Não se governa na esculhambação'
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) said Argentine President Javier Milei caused a 'scandal' at Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) convention, while also criticizing Lula's government diplomacy as disorderly. He argued that governance requires seriousness, even when critiquing ideological allies.

item.title: Republicanos mira em 2030 com Tarcísio de Freitas e não deve fechar aliança com PL
item.description: The Republicans are focusing on 2030, planning to support the re-election of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas as a natural presidential candidate, avoiding an alliance with the PL in 2026. Despite Tarcísio's appearance at Flávio Bolsonaro's convention out of gratitude, the majority of the party rejects supporting Bolsonaro's son and prefers to maintain independence for its long-term presidential project.

item.title: PL vai reforçar segurança de evento com Flávio e Michelle no DF
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) will increase private security for its Distrito Federal convention on August 1st and 2nd due to the expected presence of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for President. The event, held at Parking Lot 11 of Parque da Cidade, is expected to draw at least 7,000 people on Saturday, featuring the official launch of Bia Kicis’s (PL-DF) Senate candidacy and the ratification of PL’s local candidacies for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Direita culpa governo Lula por falta de alianças eleitorais
item.description: The right blames the Lula government for the lack of electoral alliances among four opposition presidential candidacies, claiming pressure on Centrão parties to remain neutral or independent. This includes the União Progressista federation (União Brasil and PP), which chose not to back any presidential candidate, and sectors of Republicanos, whose leader Hugo Motta is expected to support Lula in Paraíba without formally endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro. Opposition allies argue this strategy of 'pure slates' benefits Lula by weakening anti-government coordination.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula vai a unidade odontológica móvel no Rio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visits the Mobile Dental Unit at the Federal Hospital of Andaraí in Rio de Janeiro on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, accompanied by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Health Minister Alexandre Padilha. The agenda also includes inspecting a SAMU emergency vehicle and visiting the hospital’s Radiotherapy Center at 3:00 PM.

item.title: Aliado de Zema e governador de Minas há quatro meses, Simões é desconhecido para 58% dos eleitores
item.description: Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) is unknown to 58% of Minas Gerais voters after four months in office, placing fourth in first-round simulations with only 6% voting intention. Despite 30% rating his administration as regular and 28% as positive, he trails Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) by 31 points in a potential runoff and ties with Patrus Ananias (PT) and Alexandre Kalil (PDT). The poll reveals a split on whether Zema deserves to elect a successor, with 46% agreeing and 42% disagreeing.

item.title: EUA vão prorrogar sobretaxa aplicada ao Brasil desde julho de 2025; medida não tem efeito prático
item.description: The U.S. extended by one year the sanctions applied to Brazil since July 2025 under IEEPA, but the measure has no practical effect, as the 40% tariff was struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February 2026. The extension is purely formal, with no new sanctions, serving only as a symbolic gesture that repeats accusations of restrictions on free speech, human rights violations, and political persecution of Jair Bolsonaro.
